requirements.requirement: Establish the year before 2023, and the country, such that a press release dated between December 1 and December 15 inclusive reported that as of December 5 of that month the country had received a total of 16,201,670 vaccine doses, with 7,583,134 administered.

Establish that in that same year, a company's annual report stated that its nearly 2.2 million members and supporters contributed over $49 million and that 12% of total revenue came from contributed services, and identify that company.

Establish that in the following year, the annual report stated that the organization had played a role in rescinding a previous administration's plan to open most of the 22 million acres of the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska to oil and gas drilling and that contributed services had decreased by 2% to 10%, and identify that annual report and the organization it concerns.
Identify the person who was an emeritus board member in that following year, as associated with the organization and annual report described in the third requirement.
Provide the answer as the emeritus board member's name only, without titles.
